SELECT d.fiscal_period, f.channel_code, f.channel_id, s.store_id>=900 AS pseudo, count(*) n, sum(f.net_amount) net, min(f.sale_date) mn, max(f.sale_date) mx
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 6 AND 8
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3,4

SELECT date_trunc('month',order_ts_utc) m, fulfilment_type, status, count(*) n, sum(order_total_gross) g, min(order_ts_utc), max(order_ts_utc) FROM fact_web_order WHERE order_ts_utc>='2025-09-01' AND order_ts_utc<'2026-01-15' GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3

WITH w AS (
 SELECT f.*, d.fiscal_period, o.fulfilment_type, o.status
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
 LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
 WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 6 AND 8 AND (f.channel_code='WB' OR f.channel_id IN (2,3)))
SELECT fiscal_period, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) dist_lines, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) dist_rl,
 sum(CASE WHEN staff_purchase_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) staff, sum(CASE WHEN status NOT IN ('delivered','collected') OR status IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) notdone,
 sum(CASE WHEN fulfilment_type IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) noful,
 sum(CASE WHEN channel_id=3 AND fulfilment_type<>'click_and_collect' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) mis3,
 sum(CASE WHEN channel_id=2 AND fulfilment_type<>'home_delivery' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) mis2,
 min(etl_loaded_at), max(etl_loaded_at), sum(CASE WHEN net_amount<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nonpos, sum(CASE WHEN member_key IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nonmem
FROM w GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT d.fiscal_period, s.store_id, o.fulfilment_type, f.channel_code, f.channel_id, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT r.return_line_id) dr, sum(r.refund_net) refund_net, min(r.return_date), max(r.return_date), sum(CASE WHEN r.return_date<f.sale_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) early
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.return_date
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key
LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id
LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 6 AND 8 AND (o.web_order_id IS NOT NULL OR s.store_id>=900 OR f.channel_code='WB' OR f.channel_id IN (2,3))
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3,4,5

WITH sl AS (
 SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.sale_date, f.net_amount, f.quantity, o.fulfilment_type
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id),
sales AS (
 SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, sl.fulfilment_type, sum(sl.net_amount) s FROM sl JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=sl.sale_date
 WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 6 AND 8 GROUP BY ALL),
ret AS (
 SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, sl.fulfilment_type, sum(r.refund_net) rf, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT r.return_line_id) dn
 FROM fact_return_line r JOIN sl ON sl.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.return_date
 WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 6 AND 8 GROUP BY ALL)
SELECT s.fiscal_period, s.fulfilment_type, s.s, r.rf, r.n, r.dn FROM sales s LEFT JOIN ret r USING (fiscal_year, fiscal_period, fulfilment_type) ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_return_line) n, (SELECT count(DISTINCT return_line_id) FROM fact_return_line) dn,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_return_line r WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_sales_line f WHERE f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id)) orphan,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_sales_line) ns, (SELECT count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) FROM fact_sales_line) dns,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_web_order) wo, (SELECT count(DISTINCT web_order_id) FROM fact_web_order) dwo,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM stg_sales_line_load) stg, (SELECT count(*) FROM stg_return_line_load) stgr

SELECT 'stg_sales' t, min(sale_date) mn, max(sale_date) mx, count(*) n, sum(CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_sales_line f WHERE f.sales_line_id=s.sales_line_id) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) in_fact, sum(CASE WHEN channel_code='WB' OR channel_id IN (2,3) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) web FROM stg_sales_line_load s
UNION ALL
SELECT 'stg_web', min(order_ts_utc)::DATE, max(order_ts_utc)::DATE, count(*), sum(CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_web_order f WHERE f.web_order_id=s.web_order_id) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0 FROM stg_web_order_load s
UNION ALL
SELECT 'stg_ret', min(return_date), max(return_date), count(*), sum(CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_return_line f WHERE f.return_line_id=s.return_line_id) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0 FROM stg_return_line_load s

WITH o AS (SELECT o.web_order_id, o.line_count, o.status, o.order_ts_utc, count(f.sales_line_id) nl, sum(f.gross_amount) g, o.order_total_gross FROM fact_web_order o LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.receipt_id=o.web_order_id
 WHERE o.order_ts_utc>='2025-09-22' AND o.order_ts_utc<'2025-12-23' GROUP BY o.web_order_id,o.line_count,o.status,o.order_ts_utc,o.order_total_gross)
SELECT status, count(*) n, sum(CASE WHEN nl=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nolines, sum(CASE WHEN nl<>line_count THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) mism, sum(CASE WHEN abs(g-order_total_gross)>0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) amt_mism FROM o GROUP BY 1

WITH web_line AS (
  SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.sale_date, f.net_amount, o.fulfilment_type
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
  WHERE f.channel_code = 'WB' OR f.channel_id IN (2, 3)
),
sales AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, w.fulfilment_type, w.net_amount AS amt
  FROM web_line w JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = w.sale_date
),
refunds AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, w.fulfilment_type, -r.refund_net AS amt
  FROM fact_return_line r
  JOIN web_line w ON w.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.return_date
),
net AS (SELECT * FROM sales UNION ALL SELECT * FROM refunds)
SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period,
  round(100 * sum(CASE WHEN fulfilment_type = 'click_and_collect' THEN amt ELSE 0 END) / sum(amt), 1) AS click_and_collect_share_pct,
  round(100 * sum(CASE WHEN fulfilment_type = 'click_and_collect' AND amt > 0 THEN amt ELSE 0 END) / sum(CASE WHEN amt > 0 THEN amt ELSE 0 END), 2) AS before_returns_pct,
  round(100 * sum(CASE WHEN fulfilment_type = 'click_and_collect' THEN amt ELSE 0 END) / sum(amt), 3) AS precise
FROM net
WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND fiscal_period BETWEEN 6 AND 8
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 2
